fit_reason: Privately listed small homemade pontoon (barrel floats, wood deck) on its trailer, sold by owner; it is a whole boat we could clean.
findings: Grime and dirt streaks on the white plastic barrel floats, especially the lower sides and ends
Weathered, grayed wood on the deck framing and side rails
Unfinished, partially disassembled deck with loose boards in the recent photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 12 foot party barge. The white floats look like they have some dirt and streaking along the sides, and a good wash would help them look brighter in your photos. We do mobile pre-sale cleanups and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
